correctness.rationale: The balanced three-periodic normal measure (facet lengths delta(1-t) every third direction, delta(1+t/2) otherwise) yields unique centered Minkowski polygon for N=3m>=9. Facet-support recurrence ell_j=(r_{j-1}+r_{j+1}-2cos(delta) r_j)/sin(delta) with r_j=A-L tau_j gives support values a=A+Lt,b=A-Lt/2. Adjacent line intersection has squared radius (x^2+y^2-2cos(delta)xy)/sin^2(delta), so inradius is b and circumradius is mixed (a,b). Consequently dH(K,B)=max{1-b,R-1}. The exact quadratic R^2-(2-b)^2=C0+C1t+C2t² has C0<0,C2>0 and is positive at t=1 by a strict arctan inequality, giving exactly one crossover t_N in (0,1). Analytic series yield 1-t_N=3pi²/(5N²)+O(N^-4) and uniform dH=pi²(1+2t)/(3N²)+O(N^-4). Matching one-step transport plan and geodesic distance-to-deficit potential give W1=2pi t/(3N). Independent symbolic Taylor and quadratic-identity calculations corroborate finite identities, not infinite quantifiers.
residual_risks: A finite verifier is supporting evidence rather than proof of the complete infinite statement.
